name: GetFilesInFolder
label: Retrieve Files in Folder
description: Retrieves the list of files in a specified folder, with options to include subfolders, filter by file type, and sort the results.

fields.name: FolderPath
fields.label: Folder Path
fields.description: The full path of the folder to retrieve files from. Example: C:\Users\Documents\Reports

fields.name: FileFilter
fields.label: File Filter
fields.description: One or more file patterns separated by semicolons (;). Examples: *.txt;*.pdf;*.docx;invoice_*.xlsx. Default: * (all files).

fields.name: IncludeSubfolders
fields.label: Include Subfolders
fields.description: When true, searches all subfolders recursively. When false, only the top-level folder is searched. Default: true.

fields.name: FailUponDeniedAccess
fields.label: Fail on Denied Access
fields.description: When true, throws an error if access to any folder is denied. When false, inaccessible folders are silently skipped. Default: true.

fields.name: SortBy
fields.label: Sort By
fields.description: The primary sort criterion for the retrieved files. Options: NoSort, FullName, RootPath, Directory, Name, NameWithoutExtension, Extension, Size, CreationTime, LastWriteTime. Default: NoSort.

selectOptions.label: No Sort
selectOptions.description: No sorting applied.

selectOptions.label: Full Name
selectOptions.description: Sort by the full file path.

selectOptions.label: Root Path
selectOptions.description: Sort by the root drive path (e.g., C:\).

selectOptions.label: Directory
selectOptions.description: Sort by the parent directory path.

selectOptions.label: Name
selectOptions.description: Sort by the file name including extension.

selectOptions.label: Name Without Extension
selectOptions.description: Sort by the file name without the extension.

selectOptions.label: Extension
selectOptions.description: Sort by the file extension (e.g., .pdf, .txt).

selectOptions.label: Size
selectOptions.description: Sort by the file size in bytes.

selectOptions.label: Creation Time
selectOptions.description: Sort by the date and time the file was created.

selectOptions.label: Last Write Time
selectOptions.description: Sort by the date and time the file was last modified.

fields.name: Descending
fields.label: Descending Order
fields.description: When true, sorts results in descending order. When false, sorts in ascending order. Default: false.

fields.name: ThenBy
fields.label: Then By
fields.description: The secondary (tiebreaker) sort criterion, applied only when Sort By is not NoSort. Default: NoSort.

selectOptions.label: No Sort
selectOptions.description: No sorting applied.

selectOptions.label: Full Name
selectOptions.description: Sort by the full file path.

selectOptions.label: Root Path
selectOptions.description: Sort by the root drive path (e.g., C:\).

selectOptions.label: Directory
selectOptions.description: Sort by the parent directory path.

selectOptions.label: Name
selectOptions.description: Sort by the file name including extension.

selectOptions.label: Name Without Extension
selectOptions.description: Sort by the file name without the extension.

selectOptions.label: Extension
selectOptions.description: Sort by the file extension (e.g., .pdf, .txt).

selectOptions.label: Size
selectOptions.description: Sort by the file size in bytes.

selectOptions.label: Creation Time
selectOptions.description: Sort by the date and time the file was created.

selectOptions.label: Last Write Time
selectOptions.description: Sort by the date and time the file was last modified.

fields.name: RetrievedFiles
fields.label: Retrieved Files
fields.description: The list of full file paths that match the specified filter and sort criteria.
